labelling.labelledBy: Claude (AI), from the source at the pinned commit
labelling.method: A separate Python script (not the CodeAtlas adapter) read every non-test .ts file under server/src that imports @nestjs/common: the @Controller argument (a string literal or a RouteKey member resolved from server/src/enum.ts), each member-level verb decorator and the next method name. Every decorator argument was a string literal or empty; none needed manual resolution. Eleven verb and path pairs appear twice because MaintenanceWorkerController serves the same routes in the maintenance worker; both handlers are labelled. Awaiting founder spot-check (decision D-9).

scope.rule: One relationship per HTTP verb and path declared with a NestJS verb decorator on a method of an @Controller class, to that method; controller prefix joined; the global prefix (api, set in app.common.ts) is not included.

outOfScope.reason: Set at run time by app.setGlobalPrefix; ground truth v1 paths are relative to the application root.

outOfScope.what: Routes in test files (for example the class in server/src/zod.spec.ts)
